topic.title: Hot Spot Coverage versus Turbo Residency

ul.li: Dramatic turbo residency decrease may occur if the hot spot region is not fully covered.

Turbo residency is the time the part operates in Turbo, or more simply, the time it takes the part to hit Tsn-max during a Turbo event. This is a critical characteristic to design for, as longer times in Turbo are needed to capture the best performance.
The above graph illustrates the sensitivity for All Core Turbo residency with the specific heat pipe configurations outlined in the "Recommended" and "Not Recommended" examples on this page.
